hypothesis: Gate 1 of the essay 'Intention Is All You Need' holds at the kernel: the choice dividend (D12: best compliant value minus the uniform-compiler expectation) is 0 on both registered singleton tasks and on the wide-flat task, and exactly 7 and 73/11 on the two wide-varying tasks, with the registered ascending-scan best-of-k gain curve weakly increasing and ending exactly at the dividend — intelligence pays only on slack.

controls.description: The five tasks (regions and value rules) are the registered literal table; nothing is sampled at run time and there is no RNG.
Two singleton tasks and one wide-flat task pin the zero-dividend cases: no slack by arity and no slack by constancy.
The best-of-k sweep scans each region in registered ascending order; gain(1) is deterministic first-element and may be negative, which is recorded.
All values, expectations, dividends, and gains are Fractions; no floats.
dividend_confirmed, dividend_refuted, and inconclusive are all valid passing runs.

gates.criterion: Both singleton tasks: dividend = 0 and every gain(k) = 0.
Flat task: dividend = 0, all gains <= 0, gain(region size) = 0.
Both varying tasks: dividend > 0 matching the registered exact value (7 and 73/11), gain(k) weakly increasing, gain(region size) = dividend exactly.
Every value, expectation, dividend, and gain serializes as an exact integer or fraction.
Verdict is dividend_confirmed, dividend_refuted, or inconclusive.
Kernel arithmetic of P11/D12 only; the learner half of Gate 1 stays open and unclaimed.
